name: Summit AZ - OTTO Review 2026-09-11
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-09-11

# Summary
Read-only review of every OTTO recommendation queued in Search Atlas for summitplumbingpros.com (OTTO project 1c548117). Nothing was deployed or edited. The companion row-level file `Summit-AZ-OTTO-Review-2026-09-11.csv` has 841 rows with the current value, OTTO's proposal, state, verdict and reason codes. It is the evidence behind the rule that the OTTO pixel stays off.

# Project state
- Engagement on, pixel not installed, no Cloudflare worker, Autopilot off, GSC and GBP connected.
- OTTO score 84 (Technical 92, Content 33, Authority 9, UX 9). 2,959 issues found, 1,993 "deployed", 966 pending, 199 pages tracked.
- Knowledge graph: phone +1 (480) 535-6174 (not the default), address blank, 24% complete.

# Verdicts
- 219 REJECT (178 of them already "deployed"), 597 FLAG, 25 OK-TO-CONSIDER.
- Top reasons: conflicts with Rank Math, duplicate, generic copy, not supported by the live site, unsupported claims, keyword stuffing, irrelevant city links, emergency or 24/7, wrong service, homepage off limits, Utah info.

# Most dangerous items if the pixel were re-enabled
- NLP term injection with competitor names and out-of-state cities (for example Fort Collins and Kansas City terms on Tempe and /drain-cleaning/).
- Review schema crediting 10 "Google Review" entries on the Tempe page.
- 24/7 hours in emergency schema and 24/7 H2 and meta rewrites.
- Coupons and prices in schema; discount social tags on /special-offers/.
- A domain-level Plumber schema with a different phone, 7-day hours and a Utah logo file.
- Fake testimonial headings on all 10 tankless pages; phone headings replaced on 14 pages (would strip GHL tracking numbers).
- Out-of-area and Utah keywords written into copy; injected heading blocks including an extra H1 on the thank-you page.

# Related file
- `Summit-AZ-OTTO-TitleTags-Batch1-2026-09-05.xlsx`: an earlier title-tag review of 45 URLs comparing live titles with OTTO proposals; only one real proposed change (the 101-character clog vs sewer post title).

# Decisions and status
- Pixel (Code Snippets ID 23) and MetaSync stay off; approved fixes are applied through Rank Math instead.
